info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payroll Benefits Management API
info.description: The Payroll Benefits Management API provides access to detailed information on employee payroll benefits within the human resource management domain. This API allows businesses to retrieve specific payroll benefit data associated with individual employees, facilitating streamlined management of compensation and benefits. Typical consumers include HR departments, payroll administrators, and financial analysts looking to analyze and report on benefit structures. By utilizing this API, organizations can improve their decision-making processes around employee benefits and payroll-related tasks.

get.summary: Retrieve payroll benefits information for a specific employee.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to access detailed payroll benefits information for the employee identified by the unique employee ID. It provides comprehensive insights into the benefits and compensation associated with the specified employee.
